column6: Barbed wire trap entity: damages and slows entities inside, removable with the right tool, despawns after a long timer
Campfire entity: cooks raw meat/fish on right click, burns out after 12000 ticks
Landmine entity: explodes when an entity steps on it, right click disarms
Placeable mortar the player can ride and aim (sneak right click to pack up)
Punji sticks trap entity: damages entities walking over it, right click disarms
